paper_audit.data_basis: OANDA M15 bid/ask candle PAPER replay; not Pepperstone fills
paper_audit.cost_policy: OANDA bid/ask spread is reflected; Pepperstone slippage, overnight financing, commission and taxes are not verified or deducted. Percentage is currency price movement, not account return.
paper_audit.method: Confirm M15 rejection or breakout+retest, require later planned-price limit touch; first TP1/stop or 96 M15 trading-bar time exit; ambiguous bars not scored.
paper_audit.learning_policy: Advisory paper research bias remains neutral until at least 30 distinct scored signals across 10 days/3 pairs and a conservative outcome confidence check is satisfied. Never changes live entry risk gates or guarantees profit.
